recognize_zh: 中倍 LAP 染色：5 顆中性球核被染成紅色，細胞質內有數量不等的藍色顆粒，可看出強度的差別，是練習 LAP 評分（0–4 分）的視野。
features: Five segmented neutrophils with red-counterstained lobulated nuclei
Blue granular cytoplasmic LAP reaction product of variable density between cells
Unstained tan red cells in background; no nuclear obscuring by reaction product
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear stained for leukocyte alkaline phosphatase at intermediate magnification shows five neutrophils with red-counterstained nuclei. Each contains blue granular reaction product in the cytoplasm, with intensity varying from sparse to moderate between cells, without complete obscuring of the nucleus. These cells would be graded individually (approximately 1+ to 3+) as part of a 100-neutrophil LAP score.

ddx.vs: A score-0 cell shows no blue granules at all, only the red nucleus and pale cytoplasm.
A 4+ cell has confluent dark blue precipitate filling the cytoplasm and obscuring the nucleus.
